title: Modern Beta Chat Tools
description: This mod cleans up chat ranks and hides the . prefix in front of bedrock players' names for Modern Beta SMP
body:
Chat mod intended to be used on Modern Beta SMP Server 

The Mod modifies chat messages to hide ranks, recolor some names, reformat [DM] Messages, hide bedrock prefix (. or dot) and adds a /deafen command

Bedrock Prefix Dots are hidden in chat, above heads, and in map links (xaero) but not hidden in scoreboard tablist or for commands

I haven't added any settings for customization yet (*wip)

I might add a true beta chat that gives chat messages the appearance of a beta 1.7.3 vanilla server
